subject: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@cloudwell.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps

Team — looping you in to transition CloudWell (deal RW-2026-0584) to CS. Quick summary and asks so we can lock the kickoff: 

Deal context
- Product: hosted inference (tokens + embedding routes) + Dedicated reserved pool for peak batches.
- ACV: $480k; committed Dedicated start 2026-03-01; target go-live March 15 for pilot.
- Key external: Sarah Lee (CTO), Will Park (SRE) — Sarah on cc for visibility.

What closed (attachments)
- Attached: CloudWell_SOW_Redwood_v3.pdf (final SOW, legal redlines accepted).
- Attached: CloudWell_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan I shared during negotiation).

Key success criteria (customer)
- Sub-200ms 95th percentile on generation endpoints for 512-token prompts.
- Secure VPC peering + audit logs to meet their compliance gate.
- Pilot demo ingestion of 50k docs and embedding refresh cadence (initial cadence = nightly).

Risks / open items
1) SSO/IdP details (Okta) — Will Park will own but we need SAML metadata + SP config.
2) SOC2 evidence request: they asked for an inventory and retention policy (I told them CS would coordinate).
3) Dedicated cluster sizing: we recommended 2x A100 equiv for baseline; ops to confirm final sizing after perf tests.

Asks for CS 
- Marissa: lead engagement. Primary CS owner for onboarding and post-signing success. Please confirm owners for: kickoff facilitation, SSO setup, perf validation, and acceptance sign-off.
- Tessa: orchestration + timeline owner. Propose 3-week pilot plan and a 4/15 ramp checkpoint.
- Vivek: point to escalation for infra/reserved capacity config and any SLA exceptions.

Immediate next steps (target this week)
- Can we lock a 60-min kickoff Wed 2026-02-17 15:00 PT? Sarah — are you available? If not, suggest two alternatives.
- Marissa: prepare pre-kickoff checklist (I'll share MAP as baseline).

Attachments: [Attachment: CloudWell_SOW_Redwood_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)], [Attachment: CloudWell_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 210KB)]

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@cloudwell.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:34:00 -0000
Subject: Re: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps

Thanks Jordan — good summary. I reviewed the SOW and MAP; a couple notes and requests before kickoff: 

Questions / clarifications
- SSO: do we have their IdP metadata yet? Jordan — can you confirm who will send that (Sarah or Will)?
- Audit logs: need retention window expectations. Sarah, what retention window are you targeting?
- Pilot success metrics: can you confirm the sample document types and an example query that shows expected retrieval accuracy (so we can craft perf tests)?

Preliminary owner assignments (subject to change)
- Kickoff facilitator: Marissa Cole (I will run the initial 60-min).
- SSO/IdP config: Tessa Morgan (lead); will need to pair with Will Park for SAML assertion testing.
- Perf validation + load test: Vivek Kulkarni (infra sizing + perf scripts).
- Acceptance sign-off: Sarah Lee (customer) + internal product sign-off (Marissa).

I'll draft a 10-slide kickoff agenda and a 30/60/90 checklist by EOD Friday. For risk mitigation, I want to include a short rollback plan in case the dedicated pool needs immediate scaling.

--

Subject: Re: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps

Thanks — I'm good to lead orchestration. A few practical notes: 

Proposed timeline (detailed)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): collect IdP metadata + test accounts; confirm dataset access for perf.
- Week 1 (kickoff + SSO): walkthrough infra, SSO configuration & initial ingestion (sample 10k docs).
- Week 2 (perf tests): run perf scripts, adjust cluster sizing, confirm 95th pct target.
- Week 3 (pilot ops): scale to full 50k ingestion and run acceptance checklist.

Kickoff scheduling
- Jordan suggested Wed 2026-02-17 15:00 PT. Sarah — can you confirm or propose alternate slots? If 17th doesn't work, I can do 02/18 09:00 PT or 02/19 11:00 PT.

Prep items I will bring to the kickoff
- Playbook: high-level runbook for onboarding (I'll attach a stub).
- SSO checklist & test plan.
- Perf script repo link (internal).

I'll own the kickoff agenda and will share the invite after Sarah confirms.

--

Subject: Re: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps

Hi all — thanks for the clear handoff. Confirming a few things from our side: 

- 02/17 15:00 PT works for me for the kickoff. Please send calendar invite.
- I will ask Will Park to send IdP metadata by EOD Friday (02/13).
- Retention: our compliance team prefers 90-day audit log retention for now — we can revisit as needed.
- We will also need a short security questionnaire before kickoff (SOC2 controls mapping). Can someone send the questionnaire or point me to the existing doc?

I attached a stub of the SSO contact info and Will's mobile in case you need direct coordination. Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,

Subject: Re: CloudWell launch playlist & owner brief - next steps

Great — confirmed kickoff for 2026-02-17 15:00 PT (calendar invite sent). A couple of infra notes after looking at the SOW: 

- I'll provision a staging Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) for performance tests. If perf is above target we will scale down; if not we have burst policy to 3x for validation.
- I uploaded a preliminary onboarding runbook and perf checklist to the shared Drive. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCldrive-cloudwell-launch
- On the SOC2 questionnaire: I'll attach the standard controls mapping we use and I'll coordinate with security to provide any additional artifacts requested by CloudWell.

Action items closed
- Owner assignments confirmed (Marissa, Tessa, Vivek).
- I will schedule perf tests for Week 2 and share scripts.

Attachments: [Attachment: signed_SOW_stub.docx (document, 45KB)]
